name: ffoxdd
description: One engineer's Claude Code preferences: how work gets routed and costed, how code is written and reviewed, how commands are invoked, and how a knowledge base is kept.

plugins.name: dan-work-routing
plugins.description: Classify work before doing it: a safety constraint governs where one applies, cost governs everything else, never a blend. Carries the cost ordering, when to spawn a sub-agent, and how to handle secrets.

plugins.name: dan-code-style
plugins.description: Preference — one engineer's conventions for the code Claude writes and reviews: naming, structure, formatting, what not to write down, and where a published deliverable's source lives. No enforcement.

plugins.name: dan-command-style
plugins.description: Preference — one convention for how Claude invokes commands: allowlist-friendly Bash. Enforced by one hook; uninstall to stop it binding.

plugins.name: dan-knowledge-base
plugins.description: Preference — the pattern for a knowledge-base repo: raw intake never committed, distilled notes committed, watermarks per live source. Carries the intake lifecycle, the note types that decide how each file is updated, and the trap classes a new source hides. Brings no sources of its own — those belong to the repo, and keeping one at all is a declinable way to work.
